title: Claude Sonnet 5 arrives, the Fable ban is lifted, and Altman wants a "new world order"
excerpt: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5 as a cheaper agent model, the US lifted its export ban on Fable and Mythos, and Nigeria launched an AI Scaling Hub.

items.t: TechCrunch reported that Claude Sonnet 5 is a more agentic version of Anthropic's midsize model: it can plan, use tools such as browsers and terminals, and run on its own. It is positioned as a cheaper alternative to rivals. Launch pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through 31 August, rising to $3 and $15. It is the default model on the free and Pro plans.

items.h: US lifts the export ban on Fable and Mythos
items.t: The BBC reported that the US Department of Commerce lifted restrictions on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 after Anthropic agreed to proactively detect and address security risks, collaborate with the government on future releases and alert it to malicious activity. Access was to be restored on Wednesday 1 July.

items.h: Nigeria launches an AI Scaling Hub
items.t: Tech Africa News reported that Nigeria has launched an AI Scaling Hub to accelerate artificial intelligence development.

items.h: Is a paid AI plan worth it?
items.t: CNET published a breakdown of what premium AI chatbot plans cost and whether they are worth it, and the American Psychological Association looked at how AI is reshaping human skills and thinking.

water.t: Fortune ran the headline "Sam Altman seeks new world order for AI as OpenAI slowly loses ground to Google and Anthropic". That is Fortune's framing, not an OpenAI statement.

means.t: Sonnet 5 being the default model on Claude's free plan means free users now get a stronger, agent-capable model. Before paying for any plan, test the free tier on your real work for a week.
Cheaper agent models make it affordable to automate follow-ups and first replies. Keep a human check on anything that goes to a customer.
Read the APA piece on how AI changes the way we think. Use AI to practise and check your understanding, not to skip the thinking.

prompt: Here is my real work this month: [list of tasks]. Which of these can I do well on a free AI plan, and which would justify paying (and at what monthly budget in Naira)? Give a simple test I can run this week to find out. Do not recommend anything I cannot afford.
